claims.statement: Management expects the trajectory in volume growth to be maintained going ahead.
claims.quote: If you see in the last three quarters, the trajectory has been strong and resilient which possibly, going ahead, we should be able to maintain.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects the strong trend in industrial and B2B business to continue in the coming year.
claims.quote: Both industrial as well as the B2B business has been doing well for the last four quarters, and I feel that this is a trend which will continue as we go forward in the coming year.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The company delivered a high single-digit volume growth of 7.9% in Q3 FY2026.
facts.quote: As you see, we have been able to drive a strong high single-digit volume growth of 7.9% which is strong.

facts.statement: New products contribute about 16% to the overall revenues of the company.
facts.quote: And today, new product contributes to about 16% of our overall revenues.

facts.statement: The company expanded its retail footprint by adding 3,500 to 4,000 retailers this year.
facts.quote: We also continue to expand our distribution footprint. We have added about 3,500 to 4,000 retailers this year overall, and our reach is now in more than 1.6 lakh retail outlets.

facts.statement: The space decor strategy currently contributes to about 4% of decorative revenue.
facts.quote: Right now, obviously it contributes to about 4% of our decorative revenue.

facts.statement: The Beautiful Home stores network expands to about 74 stores across the country.
facts.quote: Our Beautiful Home stores network, which is doing quite well overall, expands to about 74 stores across the country.
